title: Mae Jemison and Refusing One Identity
short_teaser: Mae Jemison became the first Black woman in space while also pursuing medicine, dance, education, and technology.
story: Mae Jemison became the first Black woman in space while also pursuing medicine, dance, education, and technology. A person does not need to shrink into one accepted category to contribute deeply. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
